building_types.name: Academy
building_types.skill_description: The Academy offers structured courses with an optional curriculum focus. A focused course grants 7 uses to its primary skill and 3 to its secondary skill; a flexible course keeps its original balanced training.

professions.name: Academics
professions.description: A teacher sharpens the student's mind through Clever and a secondary discipline. Set a focused curriculum for a 7/3 split, or leave it Flexible for the original 5/5 training.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} spent the day in the Academy's lecture halls and scriptorium, working through logic puzzles and dialectics. By evening they could feel their wits sharpening—and the tutors had them practise one other discipline at random, to keep the mind supple.

professions.name: Amatory Arts
professions.description: A teacher develops two amatory disciplines. Set a focused curriculum for a 7/3 split, or leave it Flexible so the lesson varies between compatible skills.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} joined the discreet amatory class today. The instructor led them through core intimate techniques—breath, touch, and presence—and paired them with exercises in another art, so each lesson stays focused yet varied.

{worker_name} attended the amatory module on anal techniques: safety, pacing, and communication. The tutor then wove in practice from another discipline, leaving them a little flushed but clearer on how to blend skills.

{worker_name} spent the day in the BDSM and control module—negotiation, boundaries, and the theatre of power exchange. The instructor combined it with drills from another amatory art, so the lesson felt coherent but never repetitive.

{worker_name} worked on special techniques in the amatory wing: the kind that require patience and finesse. Today's focus was paired with another discipline at the tutor's choice, and they left with new ideas to try when the moment is right.

{worker_name} attended the module on more intense practices—always within the Academy's strict rules of consent and aftercare. The tutor rounded the session with practice in another art, so they left stirred but grounded.

{worker_name} joined the same-sex arts class today. The instructor emphasised desire, respect, and technique regardless of who shares the bed, and combined it with drills from another amatory discipline so the lesson stayed varied.

{worker_name} spent the day on seduction and striptease—presence, gaze, and the art of undressing for an audience. The tutor wove in practice from another amatory art, so they left with a sharper sense of how to hold a room.

professions.name: Hospitality Arts
professions.description: A teacher develops both Charm and Service. Set which one receives the 7/3 emphasis, or leave the course Flexible for an even 5/5 split.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} was in the hospitality wing today, practising charm and etiquette—how to greet guests, read a room, and put strangers at ease. They paired it with service drills so both presence and attentiveness improved by evening.

{worker_name} trained in service and attentive care: anticipating needs, carrying trays and messages, and staying one step ahead of the house. The instructors mixed in charm and poise so they left feeling both useful and presentable.

professions.name: Artisan Studies
professions.description: A teacher develops Craft through practical work alongside a secondary discipline. Set a focused curriculum for a 7/3 split, or leave it Flexible for the original 5/5 training.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} spent the day at the Academy's workbenches and laboratory tables—measuring, mixing, and shaping under the eye of a patient artisan. The tutors paired the craft drills with one other discipline at random, to keep the hands and the head working together.

professions.name: Rest
professions.description: Student takes a day away from lectures and drills to sleep, eat, and recover. No classes today while strength returns.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} skips the formal routine for a recovery day—extra sleep, plain meals, and quiet corners of the campus. Tutors may mark an absence, but muscles and minds knit back together.
{worker_name} finds a private moment away from scheduled drills and shared dorms—tension drains, breath evens, and tomorrow's ink looks a little less like a cage.

building_types.name: Arena
building_types.skill_description: The Arena hosts authentic combat and spectacle: Exhibition bouts, Proving bouts, Championship fights, Bikini Bouts, Oil & Chains, and The Spectacle. Every format preserves real winners and earned yields.

professions.name: Exhibition fighter
professions.description: Controlled bouts with blunted or wooden weapons before a crowd. Low risk, small purse. Proves form and showmanship.

daily_stories.trait_success: The crowd loved {worker_name}'s {trait} during the exhibition.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} steps into the exhibition ring for a choreographed bout with blunted blades. The opponent—a seasoned arena drill-master—leads the pace, but {worker_name} fumbles the forms and the crowd murmurs. They leave the sand with pride bruised and purse light.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} faces the drill-master in a display bout. The exchange is correct but uninspired; the crowd claps politely. A modest purse and a lesson in presence.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} delivers a crisp exhibition against the drill-master. Blunted steel rings, the crowd cheers the clean parries and showy strikes. The Lanista nods; the purse is theirs.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} turns the exhibition into theatre. Against the drill-master they combine flawless form and flair—the crowd roars. The Lanista raises a hand in approval and the purse is generous.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} is paired with another recruit for a friendly exhibition. Wooden swords, no blood—but they hesitate and the other fighter dominates the exchange. The crowd sees a novice; the purse is scant.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} and a fellow recruit trade blows in a controlled exhibition. Neither shines; the bout ends in a draw. A small purse and a reminder that the sand demands more.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} meets a recruit in the exhibition ring and takes control. Clean strikes and solid defence please the crowd; the Lanista's purse rewards the showing.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} dominates the exhibition against a recruit—fluid, confident, no wasted motion. The crowd chants; the Lanista notes the name. A fine purse and growing reputation.

professions.name: Proving fighter
professions.description: Real steel and veteran opponents. Higher stakes, real risk of injury. Proves worth before the Lanista and the crowd.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} carried the day against the veteran.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} is matched with a grizzled veteran of the sands—real steel, no choreography. The veteran reads every move and lands heavy blows. {worker_name} leaves the ring bloodied and humbled; the purse is forfeit and the crowd silent.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} survives a hard bout against the veteran. They take hits and give some back; the Lanista calls it a draw. Bruised but standing, they take a modest purse.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} proves themselves against the veteran. Steel clashes, the crowd holds its breath—and when the dust settles, {worker_name} has earned the veteran's nod. A solid purse and respect.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} bests the veteran in a bout that has the crowd on its feet. Parry, strike, composure—the Lanista rises to acknowledge a fighter worthy of the sands. The purse is substantial.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} saw them through the proving bout.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} is sent into a proving bout against an established gladiator—someone who has already earned the crowd's favour. The gladiator shows no mercy; {worker_name} is beaten down and leaves the sand with cuts and a hollow purse.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} holds their own against the gladiator but never gains the upper hand. A long, punishing exchange ends with the Lanista stopping the bout. They leave bruised and with a small share of the purse.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} stands toe-to-toe with the gladiator and earns a clear result. The crowd roars; the Lanista marks them as proven. A good purse and a step toward the champion's circle.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} defeats the gladiator in a proving bout that becomes the talk of the day. Steel and grit carry the hour—the Lanista grants a hefty purse and the crowd chants their name.

professions.name: Championship fighter
professions.description: Face champions and beasts of the arena. Highest stakes and real danger—minotaurs, mythical creatures, or the Lanista's own champions.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} was the key against the minotaur.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} enters the pit to face the arena's captive minotaur—half bull, half nightmare. The beast charges; {worker_name} is gored and thrown. Healers drag them from the sand; the crowd is silent and the purse is lost.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} survives the minotaur. They dodge, strike, and bleed—the bout is stopped before the beast lands a killing blow. They leave with scars and a fraction of the purse.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} faces the minotaur and wins. Axe and horn meet steel and nerve; when the beast falls, the crowd erupts. The Lanista grants the champion's purse and a place in legend.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} slays the minotaur in a display of cold precision. No wasted movement—the crowd rises as one. The Lanista presents a champion's blade and a purse that echoes their name.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} is sent against a creature from the deep—scales, fangs, and fury. The beast overwhelms them; they are pulled from the sand broken and unconscious. The crowd gasps; the purse is forfeit.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} battles the mythical beast to a standstill. Blood is shed on both sides; the Lanista calls the bout before anyone falls. They leave scarred but alive, with a share of the champion's purse.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} defeats the beast. The arena shakes with roars—man and monster—until the creature falls. The crowd chants; the Lanista pays the full champion's purse and honours their name.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} turns the beast into a trophy. Flawless footwork, lethal strikes—the creature never had a chance. The Lanista crowns the moment; the purse and the legend are theirs.

daily_stories.trait_success: The crowd saw {worker_name}'s {trait} defeat the champion.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} challenges the Lanista's reigning champion—a fighter who has never fallen. The champion dismantles them with brutal efficiency. {worker_name} is carried out; the crowd pities the fool who dared.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} goes the distance with the champion. They land blows and take many more; the bout is stopped to save them. They leave with broken ribs and a sliver of the purse—and the crowd's respect.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} defeats the champion. The sands have never seen such an upset—steel on steel until the titan falls. The Lanista declares a new champion; the purse and the glory are immense.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} destroys the champion. A masterclass in combat—the crowd is in rapture. The Lanista rises and hands them the champion's blade; the arena has a new legend.

professions.name: Bikini Bouts
professions.description: Real exhibition combat in deliberately minimal armour. Combat decides the winner; charm and striptease shape how skill, scars, and bodies are presented to the crowd.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} made the authentic Bikini Bout impossible to look away from.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} enters a real Bikini Bout in minimal armour, but poor footwork costs them the match. The winner is honest; the crowd jeers the weak display and the purse is thin.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} completes a real Bikini Bout without disgrace. The exchanges and result are sound, but neither combat nor presentation catches fire. A modest purse.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} wins a real Bikini Bout with clean technique, then works the crowd with bared confidence. The result is authentic and the purse is strong.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} turns a real Bikini Bout into the day's legend: flawless combat earns the win, and fearless presentation sends coins and flowers onto the sand.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} made the Bikini Bout unforgettable without cheapening the result.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} loses a real Bikini Bout after exposing the wrong flank. The defeat is authentic, the presentation awkward, and the crowd's purse nearly empty.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} fights a sound Bikini Bout in sparse gladiator gear. The result is real but the display is forgettable; applause and coin remain modest.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} earns a decisive Bikini Bout victory, then lets helmet, scars, and attitude sell the truth of it. The crowd rewards both fighter and show.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} becomes the Bikini Bouts highlight: the winner is settled by flawless combat, and the victorious display leaves the whole Arena chanting their name.

professions.name: Oil & Chains
professions.description: Real submission combat on oiled sand. Combat earns the pin and yield; chains, BDSM, and striptease shape the erotic display only after the authentic result.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} set the Oil & Chains crowd alight.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} loses the real Oil & Chains bout after giving an honest yield. The winner sustains the earned hold, but the display never catches fire and the purse is thin.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} completes a real Oil & Chains contest with a sound result. The pin is earned and safely displayed, though the crowd finds little heat in it.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} earns the winning pin in real combat, hears the yield, then turns the secured hold and taut chain into a commanding display. Coins fly.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} wins a brutal, authentic Oil & Chains bout before transforming the earned surrender into a display the crowd will discuss for weeks.

professions.name: The Spectacle
professions.description: The Arena's fully erotic main event. Real combat determines the winner before both fighters may choose to carry the earned hierarchy into sex and spectacle.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} made The Spectacle an event no one in the arena will forget.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} loses The Spectacle's real opening bout, then cannot turn the authentic result into a convincing erotic display. The purse is barely worth the shame.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} completes The Spectacle with a real winner and a consensual second act, but bodies, sweat, and desire never quite ignite. Modest pay.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} earns victory in The Spectacle's real combat phase, then carries that authentic result into an erotic second act that puts the crowd on its feet.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} becomes legend in The Spectacle: a flawless real victory establishes the winner before combat, surrender, and sex fuse into the season's greatest event.

professions.name: Rest
professions.description: Worker takes a break to regenerate health and energy. No arena bouts today.

daily_stories.description: The fighter stays off the sand—bandages, water, and sleep—so they can return ready for the next match.
{worker_name} slips away from the training yard crowd for private relief—muscles unclench, pulse settles, and the next bout feels one step farther from reckless.
